class.name: LaserSpriteLook2D
class.brief_description: How one point animation of a laser looks: its frames, where it sits, its tint and its draw order.
class.description: Assigned to a slot of [LaserData2D] ([member LaserData2D.charge_look], [member LaserData2D.muzzle_look], [member LaserData2D.tip_look], [member LaserData2D.pierce_look], [member LaserData2D.wall_impact_look]). Each slot draws on its own canvas item under the laser, so a look has its own [member z_index] and [member material]; at equal z the slots draw in that order, over the body. One look may sit in several slots or several [LaserData2D]; every accepted change emits [signal Resource.changed], which the data passes on, so lasers that are firing pick the edit up at their next tick.

members.member: On (default): the frame and its [member offset] turn with the beam at its point (the heading of the beam there, or the segment arriving at a wall). Off: the frame keeps its [member rotation_degrees] in world space.

The animation of [member frames] to play. Empty (or [code]"default"[/code]) plays [code]default[/code] when it has frames, else the first animation with frames; a missing name falls back to the first animation with frames with one error per [SpriteFrames] (the rules of [member BulletVolleyData2D.animation]).
The animation to play. Empty draws nothing for this slot.
The material of this look's canvas item ([CanvasItemMaterial] or [ShaderMaterial]). [member LaserData2D.body_material] never applies to looks.
Where the frame sits relative to its point, in px. While [member align_to_beam] is on, x runs along the beam and y across it; off, it is a world offset.
Turns the frame by this many degrees (on top of the beam's heading while [member align_to_beam] is on).
The frame's scale along its own axes (after [member rotation_degrees]).
Plays the animation this many times faster (0 holds the first frame). Finite and >= 0.
When off, the look draws nothing (its slot keeps its settings).
When on (default), [member z_index] adds to the laser's own z order; off, it is absolute.
The draw order of this look's canvas item (-4096..4096), relative to the laser ([member LaserData2D.z_index]) while [member z_as_relative] is on.
